findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Promote reappearance above natural-grace expiry**

When `blocking_probe_timeout()` raises `NaturalGraceExpired`, the probe’s inner `finally` can observe ENOENT and the outer final `lstat` can then observe the endpoint reappearing. This branch only adds a note to the existing grace exception, so `monitor()` treats it as a normal boundary transition and never adds the unbound reappearance to `monitor_errors`; closure and restoration may therefore continue if the endpoint disappears before the next sample. Raise a distinct `INCOMPLETE` failure while retaining the grace exception as its cause, as is already done for observation-write failures.
